De minister heeft de randvoorwaardenkorting terecht vastgesteld op 20%.
rationale: This CBb decision concerns a 20% Common Agricultural Policy cross-compliance subsidy reduction (randvoorwaardenkorting under Regulation 1306/2013) imposed on a farmer for failing to apply manure using low-emission methods under Dutch manure-use regulations (Besluit gebruik meststoffen and Uitvoeringsregeling gebruik meststoffen). Although Annex II cross-references the Nitrates Directive, the primary dispute concerns agricultural subsidy compliance and manure-spreading rules rather than water law, water infrastructure, or water governance.
